stock.description: Yunnan Jinxun Resources Co., Ltd., also known as Jinxun Resource, is an enterprise focused on the entire value chain of non-ferrous metal new energy materials. Established in 2010 and headquartered in Kunming, China, its business activities — which extend to both domestic and international markets — involve smelting, beneficiation, sophisticated processing, and recycling.
